{{Incomplete plot}}
==Major events==
* [[Ryouga]] attempts to train with his new powers.
* Ryouga, [[Yappy]], and [[Miruto]] meet Rabine, a street perfoming Burst Warrior.
* Ryouga and the others follow Rabine to a secret location where a Burst Warrior tournament known as Burst Heart Survival is being held.
